core_categories: Pharmaceuticals; Food Supplements; Medical Devices; Self-Care and Health Products; Logistics and Distribution Services
specialty_focus: Farmasierra Distribución is a Spanish pharmaceutical logistics and distribution company specializing in storage, temperature-controlled transport, order management, and supply chain operations for medicines, food supplements, and health products. It serves hospitals, pharmacies, and wholesalers across Spain, and handles medical devices as part of its product categories, but its core focus is on logistics and distribution rather than wearable medical devices specifically.
